title: CRC spatial combination policy 1.0
description: Application-layer weighted-mean combination of aligned point exposures. Never part of an impact definition or its hash; policy_hash uses the canonical profile.

schema_version.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

semantics_version.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

stage.description: exposure: f(sum w_i x_i); impact: sum w_i f_i(x_i). No implicit choice.
stage.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

reducer.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile; always present in canonical form

weights.description: Weight basis; actual geometries and values are application data.

coverage.description: require_full rejects uncovered area above 1e-9 of target area; covered_only normalizes over covered contributors and reports the uncovered fraction.
coverage.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile; always present in canonical form

identifier.description: Non-empty, case-sensitive string without surrounding whitespace.

number.description: JSON number converted once to finite IEEE binary64; booleans and strings are rejected.

sha256.description: Bare SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

content_hash.description: Prefixed content identity: sha256 of the canonical JSON bytes.

h3_cell.description: H3 cell index as 15 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

weights_intersection_area.description: Weights are contributor intersection areas with the target.
